Record notes

Complete brand-kit chooser and verified source-closure handoffs for explicitly supplied external collections.

Version 0.1.4 includes 1 complete skill procedures. Full audited 104-kit collection and runtime; separate Fresh Curiosity A2 assets excluded.

Requirements: Python 3.12 and declared MCP dependencies; MCP Apps supporting host for the chooser.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add brand-templates@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from a12727e05886910a5830485bab497e7cadabd8c0. SHA-256: 86b18c8ad957951f6cb2546c3e9b09e2ba8c98c8e3887b04e66fb600e2150dc1.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
